excluded_hands_in_049b.finding: Hero invested 99.8 BB across preflop/flop. In 047 tracker with float tolerance, this was capped as all-in; in 049-B strict ledger (exact stack 100.0 BB), 0.2 BB remained uncommitted, so hero was not marked as allin.
Hero raised to 99.8 BB on river, remaining 0.2 BB uncalled. 047 counted as all-in, 049-B strict required 100% stack investment.
Multiple bets left 0.15 BB behind. Strict ledger excluded from Hero Allin category.
Hero invested 99.85 BB. 047 classified as push allin, 049-B classified as deep call.

In 047 original baseline, opponent seat 2 opened shove to 100 BB; in 049-B reproduction, Action 5 logit differed at 4th decimal place due to PyTorch batch vs single-inference floating point math, triggering fold instead of call.
Hero had borderline logit between Action 3 and Action 5. Batch inference divergence caused Action 3 (Pot) instead of Action 5 (Allin).

included_hands_in_049b.finding: Hero bet Pot on turn which exhausted 100% of hero's stack. In 047 this was categorized as regular bet; in 049-B exact ledger detected as Converted All-in.
Opponent pushed all-in on river, hero called with remaining stack. 047 missed event order; 049-B captured as Hero Called Opp All-in.
Hero 3-bet pot leaving 0 BB. Correctly captured by strict stack ledger.
Hero called pot-sized shove on flop, committing all chips. Captured as Converted Call in 049-B.
